verdict.rationale: Clara is a spend-management platform with AI features (Clara Intelligence, a CFO agent, an MCP server), so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair privacy question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-usage controls. The sandbox and data-isolation items cover testing environments, not training policy, and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
